_readme: V-Guard Hard Water Protection Trial — Microsoft 365 endpoints. Edit this file and commit to update the app. All REPLACE_WITH_* values must be filled before going live.

powerAutomate._hint: Power Automate → New flow → Instant cloud flow → 'When an HTTP request is received'. Save the flow and paste the generated HTTP POST URL above.

notification._hint:
Every submission triggers an email to this address with the installation JSON as the body and photo folder path as a link. In Power Automate, add a 'Send an email (V2)' action after the Excel row is written: To = triggerBody()?['notification']?['notificationEmail'], Subject = 'New V-Guard Installation — ' + triggerBody()?['installation']?['heaterSerialNumber'], Body = 'Technician: ' + triggerBody()?['installation']?['technicianName'] + '
Customer: ' + triggerBody()?['installation']?['customerName'] + '
Photos folder: ' + triggerBody()?['destination']?['siteUrl'] + '/TrialPhotos/' + triggerBody()?['photoFolder'] + '

' + string(triggerBody()?['installation'])

sharePoint._hint_photos: Photos are saved as:  TrialPhotos/{heaterSerialNumber}_{cartridgeNumber}/front.jpg  |  side.jpg  |  scale.jpg
sharePoint._hint_excel: Excel file must exist in the SharePoint site Documents library. Column headers must match the list in EXCEL_COLUMNS below exactly.

_photoFolderNote: Power Automate flow must: (1) create folder {heaterSerialNumber}_{cartridgeNumber} in TrialPhotos library, (2) upload front/side/scale base64 images, (3) write one row in Excel with SharePoint photo URLs in the last 3 columns.
